about.label: WHAT I DO BEST
paragraphs: I translate design into functional code to build fast, scalable, and visually polished web applications. From setting up solid frontend architectures to fine-tuning UI details, I focus on clean code, smooth performance, and thoughtful user experiences that solve real business problems.

Collaboration and reliability are core to how I work. Whether leading frontend development or building custom full-stack solutions, I communicate transparently, adapt quickly to new tech stacks, and deliver production-ready products that perform seamlessly across all devices.

frontend.title: Frontend Development
frontend.description: Building fast, responsive web applications with clean code and modern frameworks. I focus on smooth interactions, optimized assets, and pixel-perfect design execution.

backend.title: Backend & APIs
backend.description: While frontend is my main focus, I can comfortably handle the backend side when needed. I cover the application logic, API integrations, and database setup to keep data flowing smoothly and reliably.

design.title: UI/UX Design
design.description: Designing clean, intuitive interfaces and visual systems from scratch. I combine modern aesthetics with functional UX principles to create products people love to use.

fullstack.title: Full-Stack Integration
fullstack.description: Connecting design, custom frontend, and solid backend into one cohesive product. I manage the end-to-end development process to deliver production-ready web platforms.

performance.title: Web Performance & SEO
performance.description: Optimizing load speeds, cross-device responsiveness, and accessibility standards. I refine platforms to ensure flawless performance and an effortlessly smooth user experience.

marker.description: A performance-driven publishing platform where I led the frontend architecture and delivered a fully usable MVP in one month.

mafert.description: A presentation site for production management software, including a real-time calculator that estimates a client's savings.

legro.description: A modern presence for a heavy steel manufacturer, with catalogs, news and job postings the client manages on their own.

audilun.description: A landing page for a mastering engineer where visitors switch genres and compare raw against mastered audio in real time.

racetime.description: Design and development for a race timing platform. Currently in progress.

bavimi.description: A premium tea store where a stock Shopify theme was reworked into a bespoke storefront without giving up the platform's reliability.

hypur.description: Design and development for a new brand. Currently in progress.

studio-parada.description: The presentation site for a branding and UX studio, built to carry high-profile case studies with pixel-perfect accuracy.

volita.description: End-to-end design and development for a window and door service company, from the Figma identity to a dependency-free frontend.

testar.description: My first end-to-end freelance project: identity, interface and fullstack build for an engineering and construction company.

nivy.description: A landmark multi-functional center in Bratislava, where I structured a modular frontend around live schedules and zone-specific data.

powerlogy.description: Frontend development across the company's web platform.

sarmdent.description: Frontend development on the presentation website.
